title: An error log for the admin
description: Admin now has an Error log beside the audit trail. The audit trail records what succeeded; this records what failed — a page that would not open, a save that was refused, an error in somebody's browser — with where it happened and who hit it.
items: Only the admin (IT) role sees it; business manager and CEO do not
A chart of errors per day, or per hour for the last 24 hours, and the most frequent errors counted once each
Details on any row shows the full message, the page, the error code a person was shown, and the stack trace
Opens on the live site for the last 7 days; staging and local testing are kept apart
pending: Needs its database table: paste supabase/migrations/20261027090000_p17_05_error_logs.sql into the Supabase SQL editor. Until then the page says it is not set up, and nothing is recorded.
